sentence: I have to work late tonight.

sentence: I left early so that I wouldn't be late.

sentence: She speaks French as well as English.

zh-TW: 我不介意。事實上，我很樂意幫忙。

sentence: Prices are likely to go up next year.

sentence: Please go on, I'm listening.
zh-TW: 請繼續說，我在聽。

sentence: The new manager is to arrive next week.
zh-TW: 新經理預定下週到任。

sentence: A number of people called about the job.
zh-TW: 有一些人打電話來詢問這份工作。

sentence: I didn't sleep at all last night.

sentence: You look as if you haven't slept.
zh-TW: 你看起來好像沒睡覺。

sentence: I used to play the piano as a kid.

sentence: The flight was to leave at noon, but it was delayed.
zh-TW: 班機原定中午起飛，但延誤了。

sentence: He's not only smart but also kind.
zh-TW: 他不僅聰明，而且很善良。

sentence: Those who finish early can go home.
zh-TW: 提早做完的人可以先回家。

sentence: I'll deal with it tomorrow.
zh-TW: 我明天再處理。

sentence: Too much stress can lead to health problems.
zh-TW: 壓力太大可能會導致健康問題。

sentence: I'm sort of busy right now.
zh-TW: 我現在有點忙。

sentence: Please bring the following items.
zh-TW: 請攜帶以下物品。

sentence: I got up early in order to catch the train.
zh-TW: 為了趕上火車，我很早就起床了。

sentence: I've got two tickets for the show.
zh-TW: 我有兩張這場表演的票。

sentence: You've got to try this cake.
zh-TW: 你一定要吃吃看這個蛋糕。

sentence: My friend set up her own business last year.
zh-TW: 我朋友去年自己開了公司。

sentence: I have no idea as to why he left.
zh-TW: 我完全不知道他為什麼離開。

sentence: I'll have a coffee as well.
zh-TW: 我也要一杯咖啡。

sentence: The movie is based on a true story.
zh-TW: 這部電影是根據真實故事改編的。

sentence: We need to carry out a survey first.
zh-TW: 我們得先進行一項調查。

sentence: The wedding will take place in June.
zh-TW: 婚禮將在六月舉行。

sentence: I tend to forget people's names.

sentence: The train is late due to bad weather.

sentence: He failed to show up for the meeting.
zh-TW: 他沒有出席會議。

sentence: We've known each other for years.

sentence: In terms of price, this one is better.
zh-TW: 就價格而言，這個比較好。

sentence: No one answered the phone.

sentence: I'll pick up the kids after school.
zh-TW: 我放學後去接孩子。

sentence: The car holds up to seven people.
zh-TW: 這台車最多可以坐七個人。

sentence: I didn't spend a single dollar today.
zh-TW: 我今天一塊錢都沒花。

sentence: This store no longer accepts cash.
zh-TW: 這家店不再收現金了。

sentence: I'm looking for my keys.
zh-TW: 我在找我的鑰匙。

sentence: Did you sleep well last night?
zh-TW: 你昨晚睡得好嗎？

sentence: I missed the bus. As a result, I was late for work.
zh-TW: 我錯過了公車，結果上班遲到了。

sentence: In addition to the hotel, we need to book a car.
zh-TW: 除了飯店之外，我們還需要租一台車。

sentence: I'm working on a new project.
zh-TW: 我正在做一個新專案。

sentence: Let me think about it.
zh-TW: 讓我考慮一下。

sentence: There are many ways to save money. For instance, you can cook at home.
zh-TW: 省錢的方法很多。舉例來說，你可以在家煮飯。

sentence: I ate too much at dinner.
zh-TW: 我晚餐吃太多了。

sentence: You see, I don't have a car.
zh-TW: 你知道的，我沒有車。

sentence: Is there anything in particular you want to see?
zh-TW: 你有特別想看什麼嗎？

sentence: Can I ask you a couple of questions?
zh-TW: 我可以問你幾個問題嗎？

sentence: I'd like tea instead of coffee.
zh-TW: 我想要茶，不要咖啡。

sentence: When are you coming back?
zh-TW: 你什麼時候回來？

sentence: It looks like rain.
zh-TW: 看起來要下雨了。

sentence: I need to find out what time the store closes.
zh-TW: 我得查一下那家店幾點關門。

sentence: Thanks for pointing out my mistake.
zh-TW: 謝謝你指出我的錯誤。

sentence: Apart from the noise, the room was nice.
zh-TW: 除了有點吵之外，房間還不錯。

sentence: This calls for a celebration!
zh-TW: 這值得好好慶祝一下！

sentence: I managed to finish the report on time.
zh-TW: 我總算準時把報告做完了。

sentence: Can you wait a minute or two?
zh-TW: 你可以等一兩分鐘嗎？

sentence: We need a further two days to finish.
zh-TW: 我們還需要另外兩天才能完成。

sentence: Her new album comes out next month.
zh-TW: 她的新專輯下個月推出。

sentence: The train is expected to arrive at five.
zh-TW: 火車預計五點抵達。

sentence: The company seeks to improve customer service.
zh-TW: 公司力求改善客戶服務。

sentence: Let's go through the plan one more time.
zh-TW: 我們把計畫再仔細看一遍吧。

zh-TW: 長遠來看，這會幫你省錢。

sentence: The mistake resulted in a big delay.
zh-TW: 那個錯誤造成了嚴重的延誤。

sentence: The shop is open on weekdays, that is, Monday to Friday.

sentence: We went out even though it was raining.
zh-TW: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

sentence: The shop sells a range of phones.
zh-TW: 這家店販售各式各樣的手機。

sentence: We can take the bus or the train. The latter is faster.

sentence: Make sure you lock the door.
zh-TW: 一定要記得鎖門。

sentence: Can you take over while I'm at lunch?

sentence: The team consists of five people.
zh-TW: 這個團隊由五個人組成。

sentence: Call me as soon as you arrive.
zh-TW: 你一到就打電話給我。

sentence: I was a student at the time.
zh-TW: 我當時還是學生。

sentence: The job pays well. On the other hand, the hours are long.
zh-TW: 這份工作薪水很好。另一方面，工時很長。

sentence: She traveled on her own.
zh-TW: 她自己一個人去旅行。

sentence: Is it all right if I open the window?
zh-TW: 我開窗可以嗎？

sentence: Prices are subject to change.
zh-TW: 價格可能隨時調整。

sentence: Don't worry, it's only a game after all.
zh-TW: 別擔心，畢竟只是一場遊戲。

sentence: I'll meet you in front of the station.
zh-TW: 我在車站前面跟你碰面。

sentence: This has nothing to do with you.
zh-TW: 這跟你無關。

sentence: Do you want to go out for dinner?
zh-TW: 你想出去吃晚餐嗎？

sentence: She knows a great deal about wine.
zh-TW: 她對葡萄酒懂得很多。

zh-TW: 我們可以在路上停下來加油。

sentence: You can borrow my car as long as you're careful.
zh-TW: 只要你小心，就可以借我的車。

sentence: How do you like the city so far?
zh-TW: 到目前為止，你覺得這座城市怎麼樣？

sentence: You ought to try the local food.
zh-TW: 你應該試試當地的食物。

sentence: She's not available at the moment.
zh-TW: 她目前不方便接聽。

sentence: He talks as though he knows everything.
